name: Banking Hub and adjoining glazed corner bays
observations: Banking Hub wording appears on a dark lower fascia near the end of the terrace.
Large repeated glazed bays beneath continuous dark canopy/fascia, contrasting with neighbouring red Flames sign.
Upper red-brick corner mass has several light rectangular windows; shallow pitched roof turns at the gable.
Street bends/open brook-side area begin beyond the terrace end.
White van occludes doors/plinths; frontage divisions and ownership of adjoining bays remain uncertain.
